gist.summary: Added Colmena by lotxo1 to the app catalog and README. The multi-model AI studio supports chats with GPT-6, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi and more than 30 Pollinations text models, with streaming, Markdown, code highlighting and an “Ask another model” option for comparing answers.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art studio, Polli wears tiny headphones while comparing answers on two warm CRT screens beside a pot of code-flowers; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently against mint and peach pastels with dark purple (#110518) outlines. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never dominating the scene, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
